title: Q-RLEDGER-BEAT: Replication Ledger weekly discovery beat, pages and guess-first reveal
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** Q-RLEDGER-VERIFY closed and ultrastable/replication-ledger exists (tenant-repos.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe replication-ledger
**Status:** closed

Second slice of the Replication Ledger (instances/replication-ledger, moving to ultrastable/replication-ledger). Build in the tenant repository, following What Works (worker/evidence.js, worker/reader.js): a weekly cron that takes the findings searched longest ago, queries OpenAlex and Crossref with each finding's `query` for replications, reanalyses and retractions citing the original DOI, files candidates with a kind and outcome only when each is backed by a verbatim quote from the abstract (machine: true, half weight until confirmed), recomputes standings and appends every move to a `standing_changes` table served at /changes and /feed.json; /api/freshness answers 503 when a finding is older than 30 days. Pages: field index, finding page with the guess-first reveal, /rubric rendered from standing.js. Then a topology entry building ultrastable-replication-ledger from the tenant repository, and a progress.json row with a stickiness block.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe replication-ledger` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T21:43:10Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
